title: Configuration Studio: what a language-model proposer returns for one clause (ADR-A138)

kind.description: A relation kind the prompt offered, by its label, for example Obligation

role.description: The label of the role that bears it: the obligor, or the holder

counterRole.description: The label of the role it is owed to: the obligee, or the counterparty

activity.description: The label of an activity the prompt offered

evidence.description: The words of the clause the candidate rests on
